precision: float64 / complex128; validated CUDA kernel unchanged; --fmad=false
wst: Frozen standard CPU WST, unchanged inputs, settings, path order and descriptors
retries: Restart each capped lead from initialization at the frozen iteration limits; append all attempts before retry/failure; final nonconvergence stops the run, never excludes a record
reuse: Copy all verified completed CPU feature checkpoints, byte-identical NPZ files, with original metadata and attempt-log hashes in the new manifest; record CPU origin per ECG
pilot: Recompute the same 16 label-independent fit ECGs with the integrated runner; VMD features atol=1e-6 rtol=1e-5; WST and names exact; physical input, iterations, limits and all retry attempts exact; Kymatio reference on the original two engineering ECGs
resume: Per-record NPZ and completion metadata committed atomically; verify all completed records before skipping; SIGINT/SIGTERM finishes the current batch then stops; an abrupt crash repeats at most the unfinished part of one batch
failure: Retain traceback, batch identities, all attempt logs and completed checkpoints; do not proceed automatically after numerical failure
scope: 17,905 eligible fit/validation ECGs; no official-test waveform access, model fitting, feature selection or accuracy-based decisions
